design_archetype: Tactical Aid Command Center (Obsidian Obsidian & Glowing Emerald-Amber)
key_features_to_build: YouTube Link Converter & Short URL Beacon Generator (Instant QR code, custom slug, aid campaign tags)
Interactive Live Geospatial Map Dashboard (Leaflet / OpenStreetMap with pulse markers, beneficiary detail popups, cluster toggles)
Location Signal Interstitial Gate (/r/:shortCode) - Captures GPS/browser location with empathetic aid mission dialog, falls back to IP geo, then seamlessly redirects to YouTube video
Per-Link & Global Location Records Table (Coordinates, estimated city/country, timestamp, device info, distance calculation, dispatch status)
Direct Aid Outreach Dispatch System (Mark pin as Pending, Dispatched, Delivered, or Unreachable with notes)
Exportable Reports (CSV/JSON location logs for field team dispatch)
instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure Leaflet maps work seamlessly in React with custom map tile dark styling (e.g. CartoDB Dark Matter tiles: https://{s}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}{r}.png).
Include real browser Geolocation API triggering on the visitor link page (/r/:shortCode) with graceful fallback to IP-based location lookup via backend or free geoip fallback.
Add a quick simulator toggle in Admin UI to test new link clicks and fake location broadcasts for demo/testing without needing multiple devices.
Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, links, and cards have data-testid attributes.
Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled plain tables; use glassmorphism card containers, glowing badge statuses, mono coordinates, and high contrast interactive controls.
